San Jose Spotlight: Data Center Company To Acquire Former South San Jose Ibm Site
San Jose Spotlight logo. San Jose Spotlight is nonprofit newsroom covering San Jose, Calif. and cities and communities in Santa Clara County. (San Jose Spotlight via Bay City News)
San Jose Spotlight/San Jose Spotlight via Bay City News
The former IBM Almaden Research Center in the rolling hills of Coyote Valley has a buyer.
Blackstart Digital -- a data center development and investment firm focused on sustainable redevelopment -- has entered into an agreement to acquire the historic campus in South San Jose, according to land use consultant Erik Schoennauer, a representative of 650 Harry Road LLC and Blackstart. The agreement is expected to close by the end of the year.
In August, the San Jose City Council rezoned the property -- which prompted concern from residents and environmental advocates about attracting more data centers to the region before uniform standards are in place.
The property includes seven buildings containing more than 500,000 square feet within a 35-acre industrial park. A company spokesperson said Blackstart Digital doesn't intend to develop the surrounding 565 acres of open space, knowing how much the trails and hillsides mean to the community.
"For decades, researchers on this hilltop did work that helped make Silicon Valley what it is today," the Blackstart Digital spokesperson told San Jose Spotlight. "Our first goal is simply to put this campus back to work in a way that honors its legacy."
Marika Krause, spokesperson for the San Jose Planning Department, told San Jose Spotlight that Blackstart Digital asked the city in June to finish an environmental review to wrap up the rezoning process. No other application regarding this property has been filed, she said, adding that once an application is submitted, the city will determine the appropriate environmental review based on application materials and any scope of work prepared by an environmental consultant.
The IBM campus was built for research and still has features that support a wide range of uses, such as advanced research and development, startup incubation and academic partnerships, quantum computing and digital infrastructure.
Blackstart Digital plans to use the campus as "a model for sustainability and safety," with closed loop cooling, advanced battery safety systems, noise mitigation and software to reduce energy use during peak demand. Bringing the IBM campus back to life will benefit the region and its residents, the spokesperson said, by creating construction and skilled jobs, supporting local businesses and providing tax revenue for San Jose's general fund.
"The campus is served today by an on-site 25-megawatt substation and houses multiple generations of preexisting data center facilities where we intend to expand capacity, subject to power availability," the spokesperson said.
Development proposals would follow appropriate environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act and go through a public process with San Jose, residents and conservation groups, the spokesperson said.
At the Aug. 18 council meeting where officials rezoned the property, residents and environmental groups said the action should wait until future development plans were known and uniform standards for data center projects were established. Councilmember George Casey, whose District 10 encompasses the former IBM site, wanted the land to be economically feasible and saw no reason to delay.
Casey did not respond to a request for comment.

Ichor Announces Participation in 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit
Mon, September 28, 2026 at 6:00 AM PDT 2 min read
Company-Hosted Investor Conference to be Held Concurrently with SEMICON West in San Francisco
FREMONT, Calif., September 28, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Ichor Holdings, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ICHR), a leader in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components for semiconductor capital equipment, today announced management's participation in the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit, being held Tuesday, October 13th, 2026, at the St. Regis Hotel in San Francisco, California.
The presentation material utilized during the CEO Investor Summit will be made accessible on the investor page of the company's website at https://ir.ichorsystems.com.
About the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit 2026
The CEO Investor Summit is held annually each year during the SEMICON West industry trade show. Collectively hosted and funded by participating companies, the CEO Investor Summit features a "round-robin" format consisting of small group meetings with company management teams. During the event, investors and analysts will have the opportunity to meet with the majority of the 11 management teams during the small group meeting sessions and networking events.
The 11 management teams collectively hosting the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit include: ACM Research (ACMR), Aehr Test Systems (AEHR), Alpha & Omega Semiconductor (AOSL), Cohu, Inc. (COHU), FormFactor (FORM), Ichor Systems (ICHR), InTEST Corporation (INTT), Kulicke & Soffa (KLIC), Photronics (PLAB), QuickLogic (QUIK), and SkyWater Technology, an IonQ company (IONQ). B Riley Securities, Jefferies and Stifel are sponsors of the conference.
Attendance at the CEO Investor Summit is by invitation only and is available solely to accredited investors and publishing research analysts. As space is limited, please RSVP early. Hosts reserve the right to limit attendance as necessary. Last day for registration is October 2, 2026.
RSVP Contacts for 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit 2026
To RSVP for the CEO Investor Summit, please visit the CEO Summit Events website or contact either of the event co-chairs:
We are a leader in the design, engineering and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components primarily for semiconductor capital equipment, as well as other industries such as defense/aerospace and medical. Our primary product offerings include gas and chemical delivery subsystems, collectively known as fluid delivery subsystems, which are key elements of the process tools used in the manufacturing of semiconductor devices. Our gas delivery subsystems deliver, monitor and control precise quantities of the specialized gases used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as etch and deposition. Our chemical delivery subsystems precisely blend and dispense the reactive liquid chemistries used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as chemical-mechanical planarization, electroplating, and cleaning. We also provide precision-machined components, weldments, e-beam and laser welded components, precision vacuum and hydrogen brazing, surface treatment technologies, and other proprietary products. We are headquartered in Fremont, CA.

Ichor Announces Participation in 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit
Mon, September 28, 2026 at 6:00 AM PDT 2 min read
Company-Hosted Investor Conference to be Held Concurrently with SEMICON West in San Francisco
FREMONT, Calif., September 28, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Ichor Holdings, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ICHR), a leader in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components for semiconductor capital equipment, today announced management's participation in the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit, being held Tuesday, October 13th, 2026, at the St. Regis Hotel in San Francisco, California.
The presentation material utilized during the CEO Investor Summit will be made accessible on the investor page of the company's website at https://ir.ichorsystems.com.
About the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit 2026
The CEO Investor Summit is held annually each year during the SEMICON West industry trade show. Collectively hosted and funded by participating companies, the CEO Investor Summit features a "round-robin" format consisting of small group meetings with company management teams. During the event, investors and analysts will have the opportunity to meet with the majority of the 11 management teams during the small group meeting sessions and networking events.
The 11 management teams collectively hosting the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit include: ACM Research (ACMR), Aehr Test Systems (AEHR), Alpha & Omega Semiconductor (AOSL), Cohu, Inc. (COHU), FormFactor (FORM), Ichor Systems (ICHR), InTEST Corporation (INTT), Kulicke & Soffa (KLIC), Photronics (PLAB), QuickLogic (QUIK), and SkyWater Technology, an IonQ company (IONQ). B Riley Securities, Jefferies and Stifel are sponsors of the conference.
Attendance at the CEO Investor Summit is by invitation only and is available solely to accredited investors and publishing research analysts. As space is limited, please RSVP early. Hosts reserve the right to limit attendance as necessary. Last day for registration is October 2, 2026.
RSVP Contacts for 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit 2026
To RSVP for the CEO Investor Summit, please visit the CEO Summit Events website or contact either of the event co-chairs:
We are a leader in the design, engineering and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components primarily for semiconductor capital equipment, as well as other industries such as defense/aerospace and medical. Our primary product offerings include gas and chemical delivery subsystems, collectively known as fluid delivery subsystems, which are key elements of the process tools used in the manufacturing of semiconductor devices. Our gas delivery subsystems deliver, monitor and control precise quantities of the specialized gases used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as etch and deposition. Our chemical delivery subsystems precisely blend and dispense the reactive liquid chemistries used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as chemical-mechanical planarization, electroplating, and cleaning. We also provide precision-machined components, weldments, e-beam and laser welded components, precision vacuum and hydrogen brazing, surface treatment technologies, and other proprietary products. We are headquartered in Fremont, CA.

The former IBM Almaden Research Center in the rolling hills of Coyote Valley has a buyer.
Blackstart Digital -- a data center development and investment firm focused on sustainable redevelopment -- has entered into an agreement to acquire the historic campus in South San Jose, according to land use consultant Erik Schoennauer, a representative of 650 Harry Road LLC and Blackstart. The agreement is expected to close by the end of the year.
In August, the San Jose City Council rezoned the property -- which prompted concern from residents and environmental advocates about attracting more data centers to the region before uniform standards are in place.

San Jose Spotlight/San Jose Spotlight via Bay City News
The former IBM Almaden Research Center in the rolling hills of Coyote Valley has a buyer.
Blackstart Digital -- a data center development and investment firm focused on sustainable redevelopment -- has entered into an agreement to acquire the historic campus in South San Jose, according to land use consultant Erik Schoennauer, a representative of 650 Harry Road LLC and Blackstart. The agreement is expected to close by the end of the year.
In August, the San Jose City Council rezoned the property -- which prompted concern from residents and environmental advocates about attracting more data centers to the region before uniform standards are in place.
The property includes seven buildings containing more than 500,000 square feet within a 35-acre industrial park. A company spokesperson said Blackstart Digital doesn't intend to develop the surrounding 565 acres of open space, knowing how much the trails and hillsides mean to the community.
"For decades, researchers on this hilltop did work that helped make Silicon Valley what it is today," the Blackstart Digital spokesperson told San Jose Spotlight. "Our first goal is simply to put this campus back to work in a way that honors its legacy."
Marika Krause, spokesperson for the San Jose Planning Department, told San Jose Spotlight that Blackstart Digital asked the city in June to finish an environmental review to wrap up the rezoning process. No other application regarding this property has been filed, she said, adding that once an application is submitted, the city will determine the appropriate environmental review based on application materials and any scope of work prepared by an environmental consultant.
The IBM campus was built for research and still has features that support a wide range of uses, such as advanced research and development, startup incubation and academic partnerships, quantum computing and digital infrastructure.
Blackstart Digital plans to use the campus as "a model for sustainability and safety," with closed loop cooling, advanced battery safety systems, noise mitigation and software to reduce energy use during peak demand. Bringing the IBM campus back to life will benefit the region and its residents, the spokesperson said, by creating construction and skilled jobs, supporting local businesses and providing tax revenue for San Jose's general fund.
"The campus is served today by an on-site 25-megawatt substation and houses multiple generations of preexisting data center facilities where we intend to expand capacity, subject to power availability," the spokesperson said.

Ichor Announces Participation in 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit
Mon, September 28, 2026 at 6:00 AM PDT 2 min read
Company-Hosted Investor Conference to be Held Concurrently with SEMICON West in San Francisco
FREMONT, Calif., September 28, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Ichor Holdings, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ICHR), a leader in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components for semiconductor capital equipment, today announced management's participation in the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit, being held Tuesday, October 13th, 2026, at the St. Regis Hotel in San Francisco, California.
The presentation material utilized during the CEO Investor Summit will be made accessible on the investor page of the company's website at https://ir.ichorsystems.com.
About the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit 2026
The CEO Investor Summit is held annually each year during the SEMICON West industry trade show. Collectively hosted and funded by participating companies, the CEO Investor Summit features a "round-robin" format consisting of small group meetings with company management teams. During the event, investors and analysts will have the opportunity to meet with the majority of the 11 management teams during the small group meeting sessions and networking events.
The 11 management teams collectively hosting the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit include: ACM Research (ACMR), Aehr Test Systems (AEHR), Alpha & Omega Semiconductor (AOSL), Cohu, Inc. (COHU), FormFactor (FORM), Ichor Systems (ICHR), InTEST Corporation (INTT), Kulicke & Soffa (KLIC), Photronics (PLAB), QuickLogic (QUIK), and SkyWater Technology, an IonQ company (IONQ). B Riley Securities, Jefferies and Stifel are sponsors of the conference.
Attendance at the CEO Investor Summit is by invitation only and is available solely to accredited investors and publishing research analysts. As space is limited, please RSVP early. Hosts reserve the right to limit attendance as necessary. Last day for registration is October 2, 2026.
RSVP Contacts for 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit 2026
To RSVP for the CEO Investor Summit, please visit the CEO Summit Events website or contact either of the event co-chairs:
We are a leader in the design, engineering and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components primarily for semiconductor capital equipment, as well as other industries such as defense/aerospace and medical. Our primary product offerings include gas and chemical delivery subsystems, collectively known as fluid delivery subsystems, which are key elements of the process tools used in the manufacturing of semiconductor devices. Our gas delivery subsystems deliver, monitor and control precise quantities of the specialized gases used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as etch and deposition. Our chemical delivery subsystems precisely blend and dispense the reactive liquid chemistries used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as chemical-mechanical planarization, electroplating, and cleaning. We also provide precision-machined components, weldments, e-beam and laser welded components, precision vacuum and hydrogen brazing, surface treatment technologies, and other proprietary products. We are headquartered in Fremont, CA.

Ichor Announces Participation in 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit
Mon, September 28, 2026 at 6:00 AM PDT 2 min read
Company-Hosted Investor Conference to be Held Concurrently with SEMICON West in San Francisco
FREMONT, Calif., September 28, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Ichor Holdings, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ICHR), a leader in the design, engineering, and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components for semiconductor capital equipment, today announced management's participation in the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit, being held Tuesday, October 13th, 2026, at the St. Regis Hotel in San Francisco, California.
The presentation material utilized during the CEO Investor Summit will be made accessible on the investor page of the company's website at https://ir.ichorsystems.com.
About the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit 2026
The CEO Investor Summit is held annually each year during the SEMICON West industry trade show. Collectively hosted and funded by participating companies, the CEO Investor Summit features a "round-robin" format consisting of small group meetings with company management teams. During the event, investors and analysts will have the opportunity to meet with the majority of the 11 management teams during the small group meeting sessions and networking events.
The 11 management teams collectively hosting the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit include: ACM Research (ACMR), Aehr Test Systems (AEHR), Alpha & Omega Semiconductor (AOSL), Cohu, Inc. (COHU), FormFactor (FORM), Ichor Systems (ICHR), InTEST Corporation (INTT), Kulicke & Soffa (KLIC), Photronics (PLAB), QuickLogic (QUIK), and SkyWater Technology, an IonQ company (IONQ). B Riley Securities, Jefferies and Stifel are sponsors of the conference.
Attendance at the CEO Investor Summit is by invitation only and is available solely to accredited investors and publishing research analysts. As space is limited, please RSVP early. Hosts reserve the right to limit attendance as necessary. Last day for registration is October 2, 2026.
RSVP Contacts for 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit 2026
To RSVP for the CEO Investor Summit, please visit the CEO Summit Events website or contact either of the event co-chairs:
We are a leader in the design, engineering and manufacturing of critical fluid delivery subsystems and components primarily for semiconductor capital equipment, as well as other industries such as defense/aerospace and medical. Our primary product offerings include gas and chemical delivery subsystems, collectively known as fluid delivery subsystems, which are key elements of the process tools used in the manufacturing of semiconductor devices. Our gas delivery subsystems deliver, monitor and control precise quantities of the specialized gases used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as etch and deposition. Our chemical delivery subsystems precisely blend and dispense the reactive liquid chemistries used in semiconductor manufacturing processes such as chemical-mechanical planarization, electroplating, and cleaning. We also provide precision-machined components, weldments, e-beam and laser welded components, precision vacuum and hydrogen brazing, surface treatment technologies, and other proprietary products. We are headquartered in Fremont, CA.

FREMONT, Calif., September 28, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Ichor Holdings, Ltd. About the 18th Annual CEO Investor Summit 2026
The CEO Investor Summit is held annually each year during the SEMICON West industry trade show. During the event, investors and analysts will have the opportunity to meet with the majority of the 11 management teams during the small group meeting sessions and networking events.

B Riley Securities, Jefferies and Stifel are sponsors of the conference.
Attendance at the CEO Investor Summit is by invitation only and is available solely to accredited investors and publishing research analysts. As space is limited, please RSVP early. Hosts reserve the right to limit attendance as necessary. Last day for registration is October 2, 2026.
